registers.name: u2_version
registers.description: USB2 controller version register. Reports the IP major and minor version numbers.

fields.name: major
fields.description:
Major version number of the IP. Software reads it to select a compatible driver.

Usage: Read after reset; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x1 major version 1 (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: 16-bit unsigned value.

fields.name: minor
fields.description:
Minor version number of the IP. Software reads it to identify compatible additions.

Usage: Read after reset; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x0 minor version 0 (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: 16-bit unsigned value.

registers.name: u2_ctrl
registers.description: USB2 controller global control register. Enables the core, resets it and selects the role override.

fields.name: core_en
fields.description:
Core enable. Lets the protocol engines, the FIFO manager and the PHY interface run.

Usage: Set after the FIFO regions, the endpoint or channel registers and the DMA registers are programmed; clear before changing PARA-independent role or FIFO settings.

Values:
0x0 core disabled, the bus side is idle (reset value);
0x1 core enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: swrst
fields.description:
Core soft reset. Returns all protocol state of the CLK-PHY domain to its reset value while the registers keep their values.

Usage: Software writes 1; hardware clears the bit when the reset has finished in both clock domains; poll it before reprogramming.

Values:
0x0 no reset pending (reset value);
0x1 reset requested or in progress.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: phy_rst
fields.description:
PHY reset output. Drives o_phy_rst_n to the PHY.

Usage: Set to hold the PHY in reset; clear after the PHY supply and clock are stable.

Values:
0x0 PHY reset released;
0x1 PHY held in reset.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: role_ovr_en
fields.description:
Role override enable. Ignores the ID indication of the PHY in a dual-role build.

Usage: Write before core_en; used when the board has no ID pin or for tests.

Values:
0x0 role follows the PHY ID indication (reset value);
0x1 role follows role_ovr.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: role_ovr
fields.description:
Role override value. Selects the role used when role_ovr_en is 1.

Usage: Valid only when role_ovr_en is 1; change only while no device is attached.

Values:
0x0 device role (reset value);
0x1 host role.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: dma_en
fields.description:
DMA enable. Lets the AXI4 master DMA or the DMA request logic serve FIFO traffic.

Usage: Set after the dma_cfg and the endpoint or channel address registers are programmed.

Values:
0x0 DMA disabled, software moves data through the FIFO window (reset value);
0x1 DMA enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: ahb_err_stop
fields.description:
Stop on bus error. Disables the DMA of the failing endpoint or channel after an AXI error response.

Usage: Leave 1 so that a faulty buffer address cannot corrupt memory further.

Values:
0x0 continue after an AXI error;
0x1 stop the transfer on an AXI error (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: lpbk
fields.description:
Link loopback. Feeds the transmitted packet bytes back into the packet receiver inside the link and isolates the PHY pins.

Usage: Write before core_en for bring-up tests without a PHY; clear for normal operation; counters are in u2_lpbk_sts.

Values:
0x0 normal operation (reset value);
0x1 link loopback.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: u2_sts
registers.description: USB2 controller status register. Reports the live role, speed, line and VBUS state.

fields.name: role
fields.description:
Active role. Shows whether the controller currently acts as host or device.

Usage: Read after the role_chg interrupt; valid when core_en is 1.

Values:
0x0 device role (reset value);
0x1 host role.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: speed
attached
fields.description:
Attach state. Shows that a device is connected (host role) or a host drives VBUS (device role).

Usage: Read after the conn or disc interrupt.

Values:
0x0 not attached (reset value);
0x1 attached.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: suspended
fields.description:
Suspend state. Shows that the bus is suspended or in L1 sleep.

Usage: Read after the suspend or resume interrupt.

Values:
0x0 bus active (reset value);
0x1 bus suspended.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: linestate
vbus_valid
fields.description:
VBUS valid. Shows that VBUS is above the operating threshold.

Usage: Read before enabling the device role pull-up or the host VBUS drive.

Values:
0x0 VBUS below threshold (reset value);
0x1 VBUS valid.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: id_a_plug
fields.description:
ID indication. Shows the plug type that the PHY reports.

Usage: Read in dual-role builds; the value is meaningful after the PHY ID sampling time of 50 ms.

Values:
0x0 B plug, device (reset value);
0x1 A plug, host.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rstbusy
fields.description:
Reset busy. Shows that a soft reset or a bus reset sequence is running.

Usage: Poll after writing swrst or after a port reset.

Values:
0x0 idle (reset value);
0x1 busy.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: phyclk_ok
fields.description:
PHY clock present. Shows that CLK-PHY toggles.

Usage: Poll after releasing phy_rst; the CSR stays accessible without the PHY clock.

Values:
0x0 PHY clock absent (reset value);
0x1 PHY clock present.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: xq_free
fields.description:
Free command entries. The number of free entries of the register command FIFO that carries CSR writes to the CLK-PHY domain.

Usage: Read before a burst of writes to endpoint, channel, FIFO, role or enable fields; issue at most this many writes before reading it again.

Values:
0x0 FIFO full: further writes to crossing fields are dropped and xq_ovf is set;
0x1 to 0x8 free entries (reset value 0x8);
0x9 to 0x3F reserved.

Unit: entry.

Limits: 0 to 8.

Unit: none.

0x1 LPM present.

Unit: none.

fields.name: split_cfg
fields.description:

fields.name: num_ep

fields.description:

Usage: Read at probe time.

Values:

Unit: count.

Limits: 1 to 16.

fields.name: fifo_log2

Usage: Read at probe time before dividing the FIFO.

Values:
0x8 to 0xF depth of 2 to the power of the value words (reset value 0xA, 1024 words);
0x0 to 0x7 reserved.

Unit: none.

Limits: 0x8 to 0xF, depth 256 to 32768 words.

fields.name: sg_cfg
fields.description:
Scatter-gather parameter. Reports whether PARA_USB2_SG_EN is 1.

Usage: Read at probe time; sg_mode has no effect when 0.

Values:
0x0 no scatter-gather DMA (reset value);
0x1 scatter-gather DMA present.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: dbuf_cfg
fields.description:
Double-buffer parameter. Reports whether PARA_USB2_DBUF_EN is 1.

Usage: Read at probe time; dbuf fields have no effect when 0.

Values:
0x0 no double buffering;
0x1 double buffering present (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: par_cfg
fields.description:
RAM parity parameter. Reports whether PARA_USB2_RAM_PAR_EN is 1.

Usage: Read at probe time; the ram_par interrupt exists only when 1.

Values:
0x0 no RAM parity;
0x1 RAM parity present (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: u2_dctrl
registers.description: USB2 device control register. Sets the device address, the connection and remote wakeup.

fields.name: dev_addr
fields.description:
Device address. The USB address that the device matches in token packets.

Usage: Write the value of the SetAddress request after its status stage completes; keep 0 until then.

Values:
0x0 default address (reset value);
0x1 to 0x7F assigned address.

Unit: none.

Limits: 7-bit value.

fields.name: soft_conn
fields.description:
Soft connect. Lets the PHY pull-up connect the device to the bus.

Usage: Set after the descriptors and endpoints are ready; clear to appear disconnected to the host.

Values:
0x0 disconnected (reset value);
0x1 connected.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rmt_wake
fields.description:
Remote wakeup request. Makes the device drive resume signaling.

Usage: Write 1 only when remote wakeup is enabled by the host and the bus has been idle for 5 ms; hardware clears the bit when the resume pulse ends (1 to 15 ms).

Values:
0x0 no request (reset value);
0x1 resume requested or in progress.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rmt_wake_en
fields.description:
Remote wakeup enable. Mirrors the DEVICE_REMOTE_WAKEUP feature of the host.

Usage: Write 1 when the driver handles SetFeature(DEVICE_REMOTE_WAKEUP) and 0 on ClearFeature.

Values:
0x0 remote wakeup not allowed (reset value);
0x1 remote wakeup allowed.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: test_mode
dev_hs_dis
fields.description:
High-speed disable. Forces the device to stay in full-speed.

Usage: Write before soft_conn; the device skips the chirp handshake.

Values:
0x0 high-speed allowed (reset value);
0x1 full-speed only.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: u2_dsts
registers.description: USB2 device status register. Reports the device speed, frame number and LPM state.

fields.name: frame_num
fields.description:
Frame number. The 11-bit frame number of the last SOF packet received.

Usage: Read for isochronous scheduling; it repeats eight times per frame in high-speed.

Values:
0x0 to 0x7FF last frame number (reset value 0x0).

Unit: frame.

Limits: 11-bit value.

fields.name: uframe
fields.description:
Microframe index. Counts the SOF packets with the same frame number in high-speed.

Usage: Read together with frame_num.

Values:
0x0 to 0x7 microframe index (reset value 0x0).

Unit: microframe.

Limits: 0 to 7.

fields.name: susp_det
fields.description:
Suspend detect. Shows that the device saw 3 ms of idle.

Usage: Read after the suspend interrupt.

Values:
0x0 active (reset value);
0x1 suspend state.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: l1_state
fields.description:
L1 state. Shows that the device is in LPM L1 sleep.

Usage: Read after the lpm_evt interrupt.

Values:
0x0 not in L1 (reset value);
0x1 in L1.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: lpm_hird
fields.description:
Last host initiated resume duration of an accepted LPM transaction.

Usage: Read after the lpm_evt interrupt; value 0 is 50 us and each step adds 75 us.

Values:
0x0 to 0xF HIRD code (reset value 0x0).

Unit: code.

Limits: 4-bit value.

fields.name: lpm_rwake
fields.description:
Last remote-wake attribute of an accepted LPM transaction.

Usage: Read after the lpm_evt interrupt.

Values:
0x0 remote wake not allowed (reset value);
0x1 remote wake allowed.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: u2_hport
registers.description: USB2 host port control register. Controls reset, suspend, resume, VBUS and test mode of the root port.

fields.name: prst
fields.description:
Port reset. Drives bus reset on the root port.

Usage: Write 1 to start the reset after attach debounce; hardware holds reset for the programmed time and clears the bit; the reset is at least 50 ms.

Values:
0x0 no reset (reset value);
0x1 reset requested or in progress.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: port_susp
fields.description:
Port suspend. Puts the root port into suspend.

Usage: Write 1 after all traffic has stopped; hardware clears the bit when the bus is suspended.

Values:
0x0 no request (reset value);
0x1 suspend requested.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: port_res
fields.description:
Port resume. Drives resume signaling on the root port for at least 20 ms.

Usage: Write 1 to resume a suspended port; hardware clears the bit when the resume sequence ends.

Values:
0x0 no request (reset value);
0x1 resume requested or in progress.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: vbus_drv
fields.description:
VBUS drive. Controls DrvVbus or the ULPI OTG control of the PHY.

Values:
0x0 VBUS off (reset value);
0x1 VBUS on.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: sof_en
fields.description:
SOF generation enable. Lets the host send SOF packets.

Usage: Set after the port is enabled and clear before suspend.

Values:
0x0 no SOF (reset value);
0x1 SOF every (micro)frame.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: test_mode
lpm_req
fields.description:
LPM request. Sends an LPM extended transaction to the device on the next frame.

Usage: Write 1 after the hird and rwake fields and the device address are set; hardware clears the bit when the device answered.

Values:
0x0 no request (reset value);
0x1 request pending.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: lpm_hird
fields.description:
LPM host initiated resume duration code sent in the LPM token.

Usage: Write before lpm_req; value 0 is 50 us and each step adds 75 us.

Values:
0x0 to 0xF HIRD code (reset value 0x0).

Unit: code.

Limits: 4-bit value.

fields.name: lpm_rwake
fields.description:
LPM remote-wake attribute sent in the LPM token.

Usage: Write before lpm_req.

Values:
0x0 remote wake not allowed (reset value);
0x1 remote wake allowed.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: lpm_addr
fields.description:
Address of the device that receives the LPM token.

Usage: Write before lpm_req.

Values:
0x0 to 0x7F device address (reset value 0x0).

Unit: none.

Limits: 7-bit value.

fields.name: hs_dis
fields.description:
Host high-speed disable. Skips the chirp handshake and keeps the port in full-speed.

Usage: Write before prst.

Values:
0x0 high-speed allowed (reset value);
0x1 full-speed only.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: oc_en
fields.description:
Over-current protection enable. Lets the over-current input switch the port power off.

Usage: Set before vbus_drv in host role; clear when no power switch with an over-current flag is fitted.

Values:
0x0 over-current input ignored (reset value);
0x1 over-current protection on.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: ext_vbus
fields.description:
ULPI external VBUS drive. Sets DrvVbusExternal in the OTG Control register of a ULPI PHY together with DrvVbus.

Usage: Set in ULPI builds when the PHY switches VBUS through its own supply-enable pin (for example CPEN of TUSB1210); keep 0 when o_vbus_pwr_en drives the switch; no effect in UTMI+ builds (DEC-048, section 14.5).

Values:
0x0 DrvVbusExternal written 0 (reset value);
0x1 DrvVbusExternal written equal to DrvVbus.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.description: USB2 host port status register. Reports the connect state, speed and frame number of the root port.

fields.name: port_conn
fields.description:

Usage: Read after the conn or disc interrupt.

Values:
0x0 no device (reset value);
0x1 device attached.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: port_en
fields.description:

Usage: Read after the rst interrupt.

Values:
0x0 disabled (reset value);
0x1 enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: port_speed
port_susp_sts
fields.description:
Port suspend status. Shows that the port is suspended or in L1.

Usage: Read after port_susp or lpm_req completes.

Values:
0x0 active (reset value);
0x1 suspended.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: frame_num
fields.description:
Host frame number. The 11-bit frame count and the 3-bit microframe index of the last SOF sent.

Usage: Read to schedule periodic transfers; bits [15:5] are the frame, bits [18:16] the microframe.

Values:
0x0 to 0x3FFF frame and microframe (reset value 0x0).

Unit: microframe.

Limits: 14-bit value.

fields.name: oc_act
fields.description:
Over-current active. Shows that the over-current input is active.

Usage: Read after the ocur interrupt; power stays off until software clears the flag and writes vbus_drv again.

Values:
0x0 no over-current (reset value);
0x1 over-current.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: sg_mode
fields.description:
Scatter-gather mode. Makes each endpoint or channel DMA address register point to a descriptor list.

Usage: Set before dma_en in builds with scatter-gather; descriptors are 8-byte entries described in section 9 of the specification.

Values:
0x0 buffer address mode (reset value);
0x1 descriptor list mode.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: win_en
fields.description:
DMA window enable. Restricts every DMA address to the window of u2_dma_wbase and u2_dma_wlim.

Usage: Set before dma_en; a descriptor or buffer outside the window is not transferred and dma_err is set.

Values:
0x0 any address is accepted (reset value);
0x1 addresses must lie inside the window.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: u2_sof_cfg
registers.description: USB2 SOF timing configuration register. Sets the microframe length of the host in PHY clock cycles.

fields.name: uf_len
fields.description:
Microframe length. The number of CLK-PHY cycles in one 125 us high-speed microframe.
